decks.notes: This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quick and aggressive gameplay, utilizing cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, Grief, and Seasoned Pyromancer to pressure opponents early. Thoughtseize and Terminate are included for disruption and removal, while cards like Blood Moon can disrupt opposing mana bases. The deck also includes some graveyard recursion with cards like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Malakir Rebirth. Agadeem's Awakening can help recover from board wipes. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with fast, efficient creatures and disruptive spells.

The deck focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach to continuously cast spells from the graveyard, generating card advantage and overwhelming the opponent with powerful combo plays. Cards like Mishra's Bauble and Ledger Shredder are used to fill the graveyard while Expressive Iteration and Teferi, Time Raveler help in setting up the combo. Dragon's Rage Channeler and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer provide additional value and pressure on the opponent. The deck also runs various interaction spells like Lightning Bolt and Spell Pierce to control the game and protect the combo.

This deck focuses on utilizing the cards Indomitable Creativity and Dwarven Mine to quickly bring out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty. Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six provide control and card advantage, while spells like Spell Pierce and Lightning Bolt offer removal and protection. The deck also includes cards like Persist and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to combo with Archon of Cruelty. The mana base is built around fetch lands and triomes to ensure consistency in casting spells. Overall, this deck aims to quickly assemble combos and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures.

This deck focuses on quickly building up a board presence and applying pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent. It also utilizes efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to control the board and protect its creatures. Counterspells like Archmage's Charm and Spell Pierce are used to disrupt the opponent's game plan while cards like Expressive Iteration and Consider help maintain card advantage and card selection. The deck aims to close out the game quickly before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck aims to control the game by using a combination of removal spells, counter spells, and powerful Elemental creatures. The key strategy is to ramp up mana with cards like Risen Reef and Omnath, Locus of Creation, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Solitude and Leyline Binding. The deck also utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Wrenn and Six to generate card advantage and board control. By using a mix of removal, card advantage, and powerful threats, this deck aims to out value and outlast the opponent in a grindy game.

This Rakdos Aggro deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer, while disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Blood Moon. The deck also utilizes cards like Feign Death and Undying Malice to protect key creatures and generate value. It includes a mix of removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Terminate to deal with threats, while also including disruptive elements like Grief and Dauthi Voidwalker to disrupt the opponent's hand and graveyard. The deck's overall strategy is to apply early pressure and control the game tempo.

This deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. By utilizing cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Scourge of the Skyclaves, the deck puts pressure on the opponent early in the game. Thoughtseize and Grief disrupt the opponent's game plan, while cards like Fatal Push and Terminate deal with any threats the opponent may play. The deck also includes some graveyard recursion with cards like Feign Death and Undying Malice, allowing for multiple uses of powerful creatures. The goal is to win the game quickly before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck aims to ramp up mana quickly using cards like Amulet of Vigor, Arboreal Grazer, and Explore to cast Primeval Titan and search for lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Sunhome, Fortress of the Legion to combo off and deal massive amounts of damage. It utilizes the land bounce abilities of cards like Simic Growth Chamber and Gruul Turf to generate even more mana and take advantage of powerful land synergies. The goal is to efficiently assemble the necessary pieces to overwhelm your opponent with a powerful Titan and lands.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game by cycling through your cards and disrupting your opponent's strategy until you can cast Living End, which will allow you to reanimate all of your powerful creatures from your graveyard. By using cards like Architects of Will and Street Wraith to cycle through your deck quickly, as well as Force of Negation to counter any threats, you can set up the perfect opportunity to overwhelm your opponent with a sudden influx of creatures and swing the game in your favor.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively attack the opponent with low-cost, high-damage creatures and burn spells in order to quickly reduce their life total to zero. The deck focuses on efficiently using burn spells like Rift Bolt, Lightning Bolt, Lava Spike, and Skewer the Critics to remove opposing creatures and deal direct damage, while also deploying creatures like Goblin Guide, Monastery Swiftspear, and Eidolon of the Great Revel to apply consistent pressure. The deck also includes cards like Boros Charm and Lightning Helix for additional reach and protection.

This deck revolves around assembling a powerful combo using equipment like Colossus Hammer and Shadowspear to buff creatures like Ornithopter and Gingerbrute, allowing for quick and devastating attacks. The key strategy involves using Puresteel Paladin and Stoneforge Mystic to search for and equip the necessary pieces, while protecting the combo with cards like Spell Pierce and Giver of Runes. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Esper Sentinel and Urza's Saga to control the game and ensure the combo can be safely executed.

The deck focuses on quickly cycling through cards to fill the graveyard, then casting Living End to return all creatures from the graveyard to the battlefield. The key strategy is to disrupt the opponent with hand disruption and counter spells, while also utilizing creatures with cascade abilities to help chain into Living End. With efficient cycling creatures and powerful threats, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and close out the game with a big board presence. The main goal is to execute the combo as quickly and consistently as possible to win the game.
